name: Mukhya Mantri Samajik Suraksha Yojana: Death & Funeral Assistance (HBOCWWB)
benefit:
1. Under the scheme, the Board provides financial assistance of ₹5,00,000/- to the nominee/legal heir of a registered construction worker if the worker dies in an accident while working at the workplace.
   1. The Board also provides financial assistance of ₹15,000/- to the nominee/legal heir of a registered construction worker for funeral expenses.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a nominee/legal heir of the deceased construction worker.
   1. The deceased worker should have been registered with the Haryana Building &amp; Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
   1. The scheme allows for application only once.
